name: Philibert de Clermont-Tonnerre
bio: French marquis, and Élisabeth de Gramont's husband: she married him at twenty-one, and it is from him that she takes the title Duchesse de Clermont-Tonnerre under which she is usually named. Souhami describes him as reactionary and dictatorial, a man who tried to bend her to his views, and records that she spoke of him as a cruel gaoler.
bio_note: Souhami, Wild Girls, p. 72. Dates: none recorded - the page says only that she was twenty-one at marriage.
